items.q: Bilateral disc swelling with headaches and enlarged blind spots but preserved acuity is what?
o: Papilloedema needing brain imaging with pressure measurement
items.exp: Raised intracranial pressure transmits along sheaths; tumours, clots and IIH hunt follows while lumbar puncture waits for mass exclusion. Neuritis pains unilaterally.
items.kp: Both discs swollen, head aching: pressure inside skull.

items.q: Young woman with painful eye movements, washed out colours and afferent defect most likely has what?
o: Optic neuritis with MS workup and steroids hastening recovery
items.exp: Demyelination inflames retrobulbar nerve; MRI stratifies MS risk while steroids speed weeks without altering final vision. NMO mimics bilaterally severe.
r: Incorrect. Papilloedema spares pain and colour early.
items.kp: Pain moving eye, colours faded: neuritis.

items.q: Elderly patient waking with painless altitudinal field loss and swollen pale disc segment has what?
o: Nonarteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy with vascular risk control
items.exp: Nocturnal hypotension infarcts crowded discs; aspirin with statin and pressure review follows while arteritic mimics excluded by markers. Fellow eye counselled.
items.kp: Dawn half field gone painlessly: ischaemic disc.

items.q: Scalp tenderness with jaw claudication and chalky pale swollen disc in elderly is which emergency?
o: Arteritic ischaemic optic neuropathy: immediate high dose steroids before biopsy
items.exp: Giant cell arteritis occludes posterior ciliaries threatening the second eye within days; steroids start on suspicion while temporal artery biopsy confirms. ESR and CRP support.
items.kp: Tender scalp, tired jaw, white disc: steroids today.

items.q: Bitemporal hemianopia with optic pallor and endocrine upset localises where?
o: Optic chiasm compression (pituitary adenoma) needing MRI with hormones
items.exp: Crossing nasal fibres fail first from below upward (quadrantanopia to hemianopia); prolactin, GH and cortisol axes reviewed before transsphenoidal surgery.
items.kp: Outer halves gone both sides: chiasm squeezed.

items.q: Sequential painless central scotomas in young man with maternal uncles similarly affected suggests what?
o: Leber hereditary optic neuropathy with mitochondrial counselling
items.exp: Maternal transmission with circumpapillary telangiectasia (no leak) marks LHON; idebenone debates with smoking and alcohol avoidance while gene testing confirms.
items.kp: Mother line blind young men: Leber.

items.q: Foster Kennedy syndrome pairs which findings and localises where?
o: Ipsilateral optic atrophy with contralateral papilloedema in frontal tumours
items.exp: Direct compression pales one nerve while raised pressure swells the other; anosmia companions frontal masses on imaging.
r: Correct. Atrophy one side, swelling other.
items.kp: One pale disc, one swollen: frontal tumour between.

items.q: Ethambutol optic toxicity is monitored and managed how?
o: Baseline colour and fields with prompt stoppage on dyschromatopsia
items.exp: Dose dependent demyelination fades red green first (reversible if caught); monthly vision checks with renal dosing protect while alternative regimens continue TB cure.
items.kp: TB drug fading colours: stop ethambutol.

items.q: Methanol poisoning blinds through which mechanism with which systemic clue?
o: Formic acid optic necrosis with putaminal injury and severe metabolic acidosis
items.exp: Illicit brew formate poisons mitochondria (disc oedema to atrophy) with Parkinsonian necrosis; ethanol or fomepizole with dialysis rescues while optic damage often persists.
items.kp: Brew blind with acidosis: methanol formate.

items.q: Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis with bilateral severe optic neuritis and aquaporin 4 positivity is what?
o: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum needing plasma exchange with rituximab patterns
items.exp: Astrocytopathy relapses devastatingly without B cell depletion; attacks need plasma exchange while maintenance prevents blindness and paraplegia.
items.kp: Cord plus both optic nerves plus antibody: NMO.
